description: This file defines a REST controller endpoint for managing Employee resources, handling operations such as get, create, update, and delete employees via HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmployeeRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller exposing endpoints for Employee resource management, including get, create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve an employee by ID.

methods.name: createEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new employee.

methods.name: updateExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing employee.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployee
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete an employee by ID.
